note: Adapted from the measurements of species no. 10, Reticulitermes tirapi Chhotani and Das, in Bose's book. The source excerpt contains only Material, soldier measurements (5 specimens), Distribution and the caption of Fig. 15, with no descriptive text, so this entry has a soldier measurements section only. Original description: Chhotani & Das 1983, Rec. zool. Surv. India 80: 316, 324—327; later described by Roonwal & Chhotani 1989, Fauna of India: Isoptera (Termites) Vol. 1: 497, 508—510. Distribution: Changlang District, Arunachal Pradesh, northeastern India (Nampong is the type locality; also Deban and Gibbons Land); specimens are soldiers and workers.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Measurements (5 specimens): body length 6.10—6.65; head length (to mandible bases) 1.80—2.20; maximum head width 1.00—1.08; pronotal length 0.43—0.52; maximum pronotal width 0.80—0.85 mm. (Head and pronotum in dorsal view, Fig. 15; paratype.)
